naam: Click Joints Pro (paid Blender add-on) and Click Joints (free version)
doelgroep: People who design figures, action figures, toys or dolls in Blender (or sculpt in Nomad/ZBrush and finish in Blender) and 3D print them at home, FDM or resin.
feiten: Free version Click Joints on extensions.blender.org: one joint at a time (ball and socket or pin), clearance in mm, measured bend range, export STL/3MF. 394 downloads in 2.5 weeks.

Paid version Click Joints Pro: whole figure from a rig with one button (joints at shoulders, elbows, hips, knees), hinges for knees and elbows with an end stop, Fit test strip for clearance 0.10 to 0.30 mm.
Prices: Gumroad $19 / $24 / $59; Superhive $12 Personal / $45 Studio, Lite $3. Sale from Fri 27 Nov: Gumroad 25% off, Superhive 35% off.
Total sales of Pro so far: 1. Reviews: 0.
We do not own a 3D printer and have never printed a joint; we never claim a print test. A free tolerance test (STL) is on Printables.
A link from the free page to Pro was added on 25 Nov. Pro still asks users to disable the free version first (being fixed).
Small team, no ad budget. Posting on Reddit is only possible from one personal account.
